title: Separated finite-type bases and their actual adic coefficient stages
statement: Let $k$ be a field. A base $W$ is a scheme over $\operatorname{Spec}k$ whose structure morphism is separated, locally of finite type and quasi-compact [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]; no nonemptiness is required. Given a prime $\ell$ invertible in $k$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, define its finite coefficient stage system to have the raw rational categories $D^b_c(W,E)$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category] and the canonical scalar transitions and associators of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension], indexed by finite intermediate extensions $E$ of $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Define the inclusion of each stage to be the canonical inclusion into the pair category of [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category].
